research_question: Does retained failure evidence support useful fail-closed abstention on a public algorithm-selection scenario beyond a standard non-abstaining random-forest router?

source.citation: Bischl et al., ASlib: A Benchmark Library for Algorithm Selection, Artificial Intelligence 237 (2016) 41-58

loss: PAR10: observed runtime for ok runs; 10 * cutoff for every other runstatus
outer_split: The scenario-provided cv.arff fold assignments; each repetition/fold is evaluated once and predictions are pooled by instance.

feature_policy.features: All numeric feature_values.arff columns except instance_id and repetition.
feature_policy.missing: Training-fold median imputation; a feature missing throughout a training fold is set to zero.
feature_policy.leakage_barrier: No runtime, runstatus, solver identity, ground truth, held-out label, or test-fold statistic is a model feature.

systems.SBS: Best single solver by training-fold mean PAR10.
systems.VBS: Per-instance virtual best solver; descriptive unattainable ceiling.
systems.RF_ROUTER: Independent scikit-learn RandomForestRegressor per solver on log1p(PAR10), 300 trees, max_features=sqrt, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=20260818 plus solver index; choose minimum predicted PAR10.
systems.FAILURE_AWARE_RF: The same RF runtime router plus independent RandomForestClassifier solve-probability models. It abstains only when the maximum predicted probability of an ok run is below a threshold selected inside the training fold.
systems.FAILURE_MEMORY_KNN: RF_ROUTER plus a five-nearest-neighbour retained-failure rule in standardized/imputed feature space; abstain when all five neighbours are VBS-unsolved.

threshold_selection.inner_split: Five deterministic folds assigned by sha256(instance_id + ':p9-inner') modulo 5 within the outer training set.
threshold_selection.constraint: Among thresholds retaining at least 95% of RF_ROUTER's solved instances, select the one with the largest reduction in attempts on VBS-unsolved instances; break ties toward the lower threshold. If none qualifies, use 0.1 and report the miss.

metrics: PAR10 among all test instances, counting abstention as PAR10
abstention precision and recall for VBS-unsolved instances
paired instance-level bootstrap 95% intervals with 10000 resamples
primary_comparison: FAILURE_AWARE_RF versus RF_ROUTER on attempt rate among VBS-unsolved instances, subject to retaining at least 95% of RF_ROUTER's solved instances.
standalone_decision_rule: KEEP_STANDALONE_P9 only if the failure-aware system reduces attempts on VBS-unsolved instances by at least 0.20 absolute, its 95% paired bootstrap interval excludes zero, it retains at least 95% of RF_ROUTER solved instances, and a residual remains after nearest-work/ownership pressure. Otherwise MERGE_P9_INTO_P8_PROGRAMME.
nonclaims: No AutoFolio, ASlib-wide, SAT-solver, meta-learning, algorithm-portfolio, selective-prediction, LLM-routing, or general superiority claim.
The VBS is not runnable and is not a baseline the system can attain without outcome access.
Abstention is a routing terminal, not scientific or operational authority to act.
The single public scenario is a bounded discriminator, not evidence of cross-domain transfer.
reopen_triggers: Input digest or ASlib revision mismatch.
Any test-fold statistic enters training, imputation, threshold selection, or features.
A stronger faithful algorithm-selection baseline reverses the disposition.
The number of VBS-unsolved instances is too small to estimate the primary outcome.
Nearest work absorbs the remaining governed-capability residual.
